observations: body L1: «lambre» is letter-spaced, though «De-» at the foot of p. 222 is not.
body L13: «15d» stands for the 15 degrees of the equator in an hour, with the d raised as printed.
body L21, L25, L36, L40: the dash of «177-78» measures 3.4 pt, a hyphen; those of «221–22», «216–219» and «288–292» are long dashes (5.4 to 5.5 pt).
body L22, L39: in the heads the dashes after «d)» and «a)» measure 10.2 pt and that between «50» and «pag.» 9.6 pt, transcribed as dashes; that of «25-34» is a hyphen (3.6 pt).
body L23-L37: heavy brackets open and close Schiaparelli's addition; the dashes before «Addit», «Demum» and his name and after «provenit.» measure 8.3 to 9.8 pt.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
